title: First Light
subtitle: Arrival at the Moon base
challenge: You must decide how to use the available electricity.

briefing.line: Your team has just arrived at the Moon base.
The solar panels are working, but the batteries don't have enough power for everything.

title: Breathing Room
subtitle: Life support
challenge: The crew needs breathable air, but the base also needs electricity for other equipment.

briefing.line: The crew notices that their air machines are using a lot of power.

title: The Shadow Problem
subtitle: Sunlight on the Moon
challenge: Find a way to collect more solar energy.

briefing.line: The base is near the Moon's south pole.
A nearby hill casts a long shadow over part of the solar panel area.

title: The Water Search
subtitle: Finding water on the Moon
challenge: Search for water ice without wasting resources.

briefing.line: The Moon base needs more water.
Scientists believe frozen water may exist inside some very cold craters near the Moon's poles.

title: The Green Room
subtitle: Food production
challenge: Grow food without wasting resources.

briefing.line: The crew wants to grow food, but plants need water, light, and time.

title: Crew Fitness
subtitle: Keeping astronauts healthy
challenge: Balance exercise with research and other work.

briefing.line: After several days of work, the crew needs time for exercise and recovery.

title: Dust on the Panels
subtitle: Energy crisis
challenge: Restore electricity production.

briefing.line: Moon dust has collected on the solar panels, reducing the amount of electricity they produce.

title: Rover Trouble
subtitle: Travelling across the Moon
challenge: Help the rover reach its destination safely.

briefing.line: A rover is exploring the Moon when it reaches an area with loose soil and large rocks.

title: Spacesuit Check
subtitle: Spacesuit safety
challenge: Prepare the spacesuit for exploration.

briefing.line: An astronaut is preparing to explore outside the base.
A spacesuit inspection shows that some equipment needs attention.

title: Radiation Shelter
subtitle: Solar storm warning
challenge: Prepare a safe shelter before the storm arrives.

briefing.speaker: alert
briefing.line: A solar storm is approaching the Moon. The astronauts must stay protected.
The crew will move into the shelter whatever you choose. You decide how to prepare it.

title: Lost Signal
subtitle: Communication with Earth
challenge: Restore communication.

briefing.line: The Moon base is having trouble communicating with Earth.
The surrounding terrain is blocking part of the signal.

title: Blackout
subtitle: Final emergency
challenge: Keep important systems working using the remaining electricity.

briefing.line: The solar storm has arrived. The Moon base's batteries are running low after earlier power problems.

title: First Light
subtitle: Arrival at ASTER-9
challenge: Decide which systems to power first while keeping enough energy for later.

briefing.line: After months of travelling through space, your crew has finally reached Mars.
But the mission has barely begun, and there's already a problem.
The base is running on limited battery power. Outside, the solar panels are beginning to collect sunlight, but they cannot power every system at once.
Your crew needs electricity for lighting, heating, and essential equipment.

title: Breathing Room
subtitle: Life support
challenge: Protect the crew's air supply without using too much electricity.

briefing.line: The base is now operating, and the crew begins setting up their new home.
Suddenly, a warning appears on the main display.
On Mars, the outside air is mostly carbon dioxide and cannot be breathed by humans.
Inside the base, special machines must provide oxygen and remove the carbon dioxide that the crew breathes out.
These machines require electricity, and the base is still short on power.

title: The Green Room
subtitle: Food production
challenge: Balance the greenhouse's needs with the base's limited resources.

briefing.line: One week has passed since your arrival.
The base is stable, but food supplies will not last forever. The crew must begin growing fresh food.
Inside the greenhouse, rows of small plants sit beneath powerful LED lights.
The plants could provide fresh food in the future, but the greenhouse uses resources needed elsewhere.
Turning down the lights would save electricity, but it could also slow plant growth.

title: Dust on the Panels
subtitle: Energy crisis
challenge: Find a way to restore energy before the next Martian night.

briefing.line: A strong wind has carried fine Martian dust across the landing site.
By morning, the base is receiving far less solar energy than expected.
The crew checks the outdoor cameras. Several solar panels are covered in a thick layer of red dust.
A maintenance robot could help clear the panels, but operating it would use some of the electricity you are trying to save.
Waiting might conserve power now, but the batteries could continue to lose charge.

title: Radiation Shelter
subtitle: Solar storm warning
challenge: Prepare the shelter and protect the crew without exhausting the base's remaining resources.

briefing.line: The crew has been working hard to recover from the recent energy problems.
Then an urgent warning arrives from a spacecraft monitoring the Sun.

briefing.speaker: alert
briefing.line: SOLAR STORM WARNING. High-energy particles are approaching Mars.
Unlike Earth, Mars does not have a global magnetic field to help shield the planet from these particles.
The crew can move into a specially protected shelter. However, preparing it will require electricity and supplies.
The storm is still some distance away.

title: Blackout
subtitle: Final emergency
challenge: Make the final decision in 10 seconds and keep the crew's essential systems running.

briefing.line: The solar storm has reached Mars.
Inside ASTER-9, the crew waits in the radiation shelter.
Suddenly, the communication signal becomes unreliable. At the same time, the base's already weakened batteries reach a dangerously low level.
The main lights switch off, leaving only the emergency displays.

briefing.speaker: aster
briefing.line: Commander, backup power is nearly empty. We must reduce energy use immediately.
The oxygen system, shelter equipment, and communication system all need electricity. There isn't enough power to run everything normally.

briefing.speaker: alert
briefing.line: FINAL EMERGENCY DECISION. Every earlier decision has brought you to this moment.

title: The Cold Zone
subtitle: Extreme temperatures
challenge: Protect the equipment from low temperatures.

briefing.line: A scientific instrument has been left outside in a very cold, shadowed area.

title: Moonquake Alert
subtitle: Moonquakes
challenge: Make sure the base is safe.

briefing.line: Sensors inside the base detect small vibrations coming from the ground.

title: Small Impacts
subtitle: Meteorite impacts
challenge: Protect important equipment and check for damage.

briefing.line: Cameras detect a new impact mark near some equipment outside the Moon base.

title: The Final Samples
subtitle: Collecting Moon rocks
challenge: Collect useful samples without wasting time or supplies.

briefing.line: The crew is preparing to finish its research mission.
There is limited time and space to collect rock samples.
